text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business to the May 2018, Scarborough Community Council agenda which asks staff to report on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals at Ellesmere Road and Grangeway Avenue. I would like to move the motion below that would create a safer environment for the pedestrians and drivers of the local community by requesting that: Staff report back to the June 2018, Scarborough Community Council with a report on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals at Ellesmere Road at Grangeway Avenue. If you have any questions regarding this matter, please feel free to contact me at 416-392-0204.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report to the July 4, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council on the feasibility of installing Traffic Control Signals at Ellesmere Road and Grangeway Avenue.
